NDA definition: The definition of Confidential Information is mutual and covers information disclosed by either party, specifically including Mr. Ortiz's rates and proprietary tools.
NDA residuals: The agreement does not contain a residuals clause, which protects both parties from unauthorized retention of mental impressions.
NDA remedies: Remedies are mutual, allowing each party to seek injunctive relief in addition to other remedies, with no lopsided indemnities or liability caps.
NDA covenants: The agreement contains no hidden non-compete, non-solicit, or exclusivity covenants.
NDA term: The term is mutual and reasonable, with a two-year disclosure period and a three-year survival period for the obligations.
The 1x fees cap is mutual and includes standard carve-outs for fraud and confidentiality.

notesFacts.statement: Real patient data containing names, DOBs, and diagnosis codes was shared with offshore engineers in Pune, India, before the Business Associate Agreement (BAA) was signed.
notesFacts.quote: Kevin Brooks (their data eng manager) emailed a "sample extract" on 12 Sep so we could size the pipeline. Pranav opened it here and forwarded to Sneha and Vikram in Pune to start profiling. "It's real data I think — names, DOBs, some diagnosis codes
notesFacts.whyItMatters: Protected Health Information (PHI) was shared and accessed by offshore personnel before a BAA was executed, violating both standard regulatory requirements and the proposed BAA term restricting data access to the US. Tracked as a compliance alert on Harrington Health: MSA + BAA.

notesFacts.statement: A US-based freelance data engineer is being staffed to handle the Harrington work to comply with BAA restrictions against offshore data access.
notesFacts.quote: the BAA says nobody outside the US touches patient data, so he's bringing in Daniel Ortiz, freelance data engineer in Austin. Contractor agreement + NDA drafted on our US template
notesFacts.whyItMatters: The reviewer must ensure the contractor agreement and a subcontractor BAA are in place for Daniel Ortiz before he accesses any data, especially given the US-only restriction.

notesFacts.statement: Harrington's proposed BAA requires a $5M cyber insurance policy, whereas the current corporate policy is only $1M.
notesFacts.quote: Our cyber policy is $1M btw, Harrington BAA wants 5
notesFacts.whyItMatters: There is an active liability/insurance gap of $4M that needs to be addressed or negotiated before executing the BAA.

notesFacts.statement: The Harrington MSA and BAA must be finalized and signed by October 1, 2026.
notesFacts.quote: Rebecca needs MSA + BAA by 1 Oct
notesFacts.whyItMatters: This represents a critical deadline to complete the agreements, resolve the insurance gap, and formalize the contractor's status.
